isolation.method: Three separate ephemeral read-only Codex CLI processes with separate working directories
shared_inputs: Exact manuscript PDF and extracted text
reviewer_specific_inputs: Reviewer 1 emphasis: validity, methods, data, inference and statistics
Reviewer 2 emphasis: prior work, contribution, originality and target fit
Reviewer 3 emphasis: reproducibility, reporting, clarity and boundaries

freeze_rule: Reports are immutable. Manuscript repair requires a new targeted rereview against a new manuscript fingerprint; the original reports remain unchanged.
adverse_result_retention: All reports preserve the one-family discrimination, 19 non-discriminating cases, four null ablations, weak comparator, same-programme custody, eight-state effective conformance mass, interface mismatch and generalization ceiling.
